newsitem.title: USA: Apple seeks buyer, executives say - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Apple seeks buyer, executives say - NYT.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc is actively looking for a friendly merger partner, according to several executives close to the company, the New York Times said on Thursday.
One executive who does business with Apple said Apple employees told him the company was again in talks with Sun Microsystems, the paper said.

On Wednesday, Saudi Arabia's Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud said he owned more than five percent of the computer maker's stock, recently buying shares on the open market for a total of $115 million.
Oracle Corp Chairman Larry Ellison confirmed on March 27 he had formed an independent investor group to gauge interest in taking over Apple.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
